SIKA® VISCOCRETE®-10: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® ViscoCrete®-10, March 2024, Version 01.04 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/l/sika_viscocrete_-10.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® ViscoCrete®-10 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2024, Version 01.04).
1.2 Product description. Sika® ViscoCrete®-10 is a third generation superplasticiser for concrete and mortar. It meets the requirements for high range water reducing superplasticisers according to AS1478.1-2000.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sika® ViscoCrete®-10 is especially suitable for concrete mixes with extended transportation times and extended workability requirements, high water reduction and improved flow characteristics. Sika® ViscoCrete®-10 is mainly used for the following applications:
    - Concrete with ultra high water reduction (up to 30%)
    - High performance concrete
    - Concrete in hot weather and with extended transportation and workability requirements
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® ViscoCrete®-10
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: HWR- High Range Water Reducer
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports. Sika® ViscoCrete® 10 meets and exceeds all requirements of Australian Standard 1478.1-2000 for High Range Water Reducer Admixture (HWR).
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS1478.1-2000: cited elsewhere in the data sheet. Where: Description (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer. Sika® ViscoCrete®-10 is a powerful superplasticiser which acts through several different mechanisms including surface adsorption and sterical effects separating the cementitious binder particles. The following advantageous properties are achieved:
    - High water reduction, resulting in high density, high strength and reduced permeability
    - Superior plasticising effect, resulting in improved flow, placing and compaction characteristics
    - Reduced shrinkage during curing and reduced creep when hardened
    Sika® ViscoCrete®-10 does not contain chlorides or any other ingredients which promote the corrosion of steel. It is therefore suitable for use in reinforced and pre-stressed concrete structures.
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Modified polycarboxylates in water
    - Appearance and colour: Light brownish liquid
    - Density: Density: 1.07 kg/l (at +20°C) approximately
2.6 Concreting guidance. Laboratory trials shall be carried out before concreting on site, especially when using a new mix design or producing new concrete components. Fresh concrete must be cured properly and curing applied as early as possible.
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Bulk Deliveries; 1000 litre IBC; 10 litre pail
    - Shelf life: 12 months from date of production if stored properly in undamaged unopened, original sealed packaging.
    - Storage conditions: In dry conditions at temperatures between +5°C and +35°C. Protect from direct sunlight.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (March 2024, Version 01.04) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2024, Version 01.04) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Recommended dosage: Recommended dosage for concrete: 250 ml to 2000 ml per 100 kg of total cementitious material. Optimum dosage should be determined by site trials.
4.3 Dispensing. Sika® ViscoCrete®-10 is added to the gauging water or added with it into the concrete mixer. To take advantage of the high water reduction, a wet mixing time, which is depending on the mixing conditions and mixer performance, of at least 60 seconds per cubic metre after the admixture addition is recommended. Sika® ViscoCrete®-10 shall not be added to dry cement.
4.4 Compatibility. Sika® ViscoCrete® can be used in conjunction with all the admixtures manufactured by Sika Australia PTY Limited with the exclusion of Sikament ® NN. All admixtures must be added separately. For additional information, please contact Sika technical personnel.
4.5 Limitations and important considerations.
    - When using Sika® ViscoCrete®-10 a suitable mix design has to be taken into account and local material sources shall be trialled.
    - Do not use with napthalene based admixtures. Excessive water addition or overdosing may cause bleeding or segregation.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (March 2024, Version 01.04) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® ViscoCrete®-10, March 2024, Version 01.04, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/l/sika_viscocrete_-10.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sika ViscoCrete-10, version 09/11/2022, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/0/Sika%20Viscocrete%2010.pdf
    - Environmental Product Declaration: EPD Sika® ViscoCrete®-10, version 12/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/r/epd-sika-viscocrete-10.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
